title_cn: 法国承诺为家庭和企业提供 1 亿欧元的野火援助
summary: France is mobilizing more than €100 million ($116 million) in aid to rebuild homes and issue tax relief to businesses devastated by this summer’s wildfires.

title: Trump Threatens Oman Over Hormuz
title_cn: 特朗普就霍尔木兹海峡威胁阿曼
summary: President Donald Trump threatened to bomb Oman if the country gets in the way of the US blockade of Iranian ships in the Strait of Hormuz, Fox News reported. (Source: Bloomberg)
